query: history of token caching decisions in the gateway

seed_memories.content: History of token caching decisions in the gateway: we started with a naive 5-minute TTL, moved to a sliding window keyed by user id when the auth provider rate-limited us, then settled on a two-tier cache with per-token TTL plus a revocation bus on Redis pub/sub.
seed_memories.summary: History of token caching decisions in the gateway: TTL, sliding, two-tier + revocation bus.
